title: Cheerful Young Men on Frozen Lake, 1952 Winter Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Winter
1951-2

6 Holy Novices (+ Fred Bigiel)
(Gus is home with
his crutches)

852
description: A group of six cheerful young men pose together outdoors on a wide sheet of cleared ice, likely a frozen lake or pond, during the winter of 1951–1952. Several wear mid-century Buffalo plaid jackets, caps, ear warmers, and winter gloves. In the background, bare trees line the snowy perimeter, alongside a Jeep fitted with a snowplow and a small stone or wood building. The handwritten note on the reverse indicates they are seminary novices enjoying a winter recreational outing.
